extName.message: Web Table Exporter: 导出表格

extDesc.message: Export web tables to Excel/CSV/JSON/MD/HTML. Free, open source, no tracking. Auto-collects virtual-scroll & paginated tables.

noteStopped.message: collection stopped, kept the $N$ collected page(s)

noteTableLost.message: table lost after paging, kept the $N$ collected page(s)

noteHeaderChanged.message: table header changed after paging, kept the $N$ collected page(s)

noteNoNew.message: no new data on consecutive pages, stopped

noteStayLast.message: page left on the last page

pageBtnTitleDefault.message: Auto-collect the selected table across pages: open to set a page limit, or designate the next-page button if no paginator is detected

pageBtnTitleMulti.message: Paginated collection does not support multi-table selection: deselect the other tables first and keep only the one to collect

pageMenuSub.message: Leave empty to collect all pages; if no paginator is detected you will be asked to click the "next page" button

pageLimitTitle.message: Collect only the first N pages; leave empty for all pages

pageLimitAria.message: Maximum pages to collect (empty = all pages)

toastCopied.message: Copied $N$ data rows to the clipboard (paste into any spreadsheet)

errClipboard.message: The browser did not grant clipboard write permission

hintNoTables.message: No tables found on this page

toastNoTables.message: No tables found on this page; nothing to select or export

toastCollectingClick.message: Collecting table data; click "Stop" to abort

toastTableGone.message: The selected table is no longer on the page; please re-select it before collecting

toastLinkBlocked.message: Links are disabled while selecting; press Esc to exit, then navigate

toastTablesRemoved.message: Selected tables were removed by a page refresh

toastTablesRemovedN.message: Selected tables were removed by a page refresh ($N$)

hintVirtual.message: Scrolling to collect the virtual table…

hintVirtualN.message: Collecting the virtual table… $N$ rows so far

toastVirtualAuto.message: Virtual-scroll tables are fully collected automatically when selected

hintSpecify.message: No paginator detected; click the "next page" button (Esc to cancel)

previewTitle.message: Export preview (green = new split columns; strikethrough = excluded)

noteMerges.message: This table has merged cells; split and column filtering are unavailable (column format still works)

previewMerges.message: Merged cells in this table: split and filter unavailable (column format still applies)

fmtNumberTitle.message: Number format: values are written to Excel as numbers (thousand separators are stripped; unparseable values stay as text); applies to this column and its split columns

hintSplitBlock.message: Suggested: split by line breaks (column has multi-line text)

hintSplitCtrl.message: Suggested: split control values (column contains form controls)

hintSplitDefault.message: Split into multiple columns (controls / line breaks / delimiter)

noSplitMerges.message: Tables with merged cells cannot be split

errKeepOne.message: Table $N$: keep at least one exported column

errCount.message: $N$ invalid setting(s) — marked red; fix and retry

btnResetTitle.message: Reset this table to the default column settings (no split, all columns exported, text format); click Save to apply and clear the saved settings for this page

toastResetDone.message: Saved column settings cleared; default export restored

toastSaved.message: Column settings saved and remembered; they take effect on export
